blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed a bug that awarded the wrong Player Icon to players for Season 4 of Competitive 6v6 Lockout Elimination Fixed a bug that caused player ranks to not appear properly on the hero select and tab screens

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: Sombra Fixed a bug that caused Sombra’s neck to be outstretched during her "Pumpkinette" victory pose Torbjörn Fixed a bug that caused Torbjörn’s fingers to clip through his mallet during his "Taking a Break" victory pose
